confidence: medium — see sensitivity_envelope; the scenario's own config (cast order, items/ability haste, splinters option) lives in scripts/, which this investigation was forbidden to read, so the recomputation is done at the canonical configuration

evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.reading: Dark Sphere has a STATIC 7 s cooldown at every rank; generic ability haste / CDR does NOT shorten it.

sources_quoted.quote: "Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste." leveling attribute "Ability Haste" values [10, 20, 30]
sources_quoted.reading: The ONLY haste that reaches Q is R's rank-scaled passive: 10/20/30 AH at R1/R2/R3.

sources_quoted.quote: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2."
sources_quoted.reading: A second Q charge exists ONLY at >= 40 Splinters of Wrath, and is stocked periodically (not handed out at fight start).
W is 8 s at rank 5 and IS haste-scaled.

sources_quoted.quote: E cooldown [15,15,15,15,15] affectedByCdr true, castTime 0.25; R cooldown [120,100,80] affectedByCdr true, castTime 0.25
sources_quoted.reading: E is 15 s flat (haste-scaled); R is 80 s at rank 3.

sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on **one shared timeline** ... each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`) ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
sources_quoted.reading: The cast timeline is a greedy superposition of per-ability deterministic renewal schedules; the cast order only breaks ties among simultaneously-ready abilities.

sources_quoted.quote: Ability haste (`effective_cooldown`) | `cd' = cd*100/(100+AH)` ... R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)
sources_quoted.reading: Effective cooldown formula, and R contributes exactly one cast to a 60 s timed fight.
The second Dark Sphere charge is a distinct Q2 slot gated behind the splinters option; with the option below 40 there is exactly one Q charge.

independent_computation.configuration_assumed: level 18, ranks Q5/W5/E5/R3, 60 s timed fight, no ability haste from items (AH = 0), splinters below 40 (single Dark Sphere charge, Q2 unavailable), custom cast order = some permutation of {Q, W, E, R}

effective_cooldowns.Q: 7 s static base; affectedByCdr = false so item/rune haste does not apply; R rank 3 passive grants 30 AH to Dark Sphere only => 7 * 100/(100+30) = 5.3846 s
effective_cooldowns.R: 80 s, and one cast per timed fight by model constraint

shared_timeline.slot: Q or W or E (all up at t=0; the custom order breaks this tie)
R (blocked behind the 0.25 s E cast; single R cast)

independent_computation.why_the_permutation_does_not_matter: All of Q/W/E/R are off cooldown at t=0, so the custom order only decides which of them fills indices 0-2; the opening always consumes 4 slots, and indices 4,5,6 are then fixed by cooldown arithmetic as Q, W, Q.
independent_computation.robustness_check: The same index-6 = Q result holds even if the engine ignores R's Q-haste passive (Q = 7 s flat): schedule becomes Q@0, W@0, E@0, R@0.25, Q@7, W@8, Q@14 -> index 6 = Q. It also holds if generic haste were (wrongly) applied to Q. At AH = 0 with a four-ability order, every Q-cooldown model tested yields Q at index 6.

when_W_would_be_correct: Total ability haste > 48.6 (so W's 8 s base falls below Q's static 5.3846 s) AND the custom cast order excludes E — at AH >= ~40 with E present, index 6 becomes E (E's 2nd cast at 15*100/(100+AH) lands before W's 3rd), not W.
An E-free three-slot order that includes R (e.g. Q,W,R): the opening then consumes only 3 slots and index 6 lands on W@16.0.
sensitivity_envelope.when_both_would_be_wrong: An E-containing order with total ability haste >= ~40: the source-correct index 6 is E (e.g. AH = 50 -> E@10.0 precedes W@10.67 and Q@10.77).
sensitivity_envelope.sweep: 38 cast orders (all permutations of subsets of {Q,W,E,R} containing both Q and W) x AH in {0,10,...,80} were simulated under four Q-cooldown/charge models. Under the source-correct model (Q = 5.3846 s static, single charge) index 6 is Q for 27/38 orders at AH = 0 (including all 24 four-ability permutations) and W for only 5/38; W at index 6 requires exactly the corner cases listed above.

reasoning_for_verdict: Every sourced fact about Dark Sphere is a restriction on how often it can be cast (static 7 s cooldown immune to item haste; a second charge only past 40 Splinters of Wrath), and the one fact that speeds it up (R's 10/20/30 ability haste, 30 at rank 3) is rank-based and present from the fight's start. Feeding those cooldowns into the shared-timeline renewal schedule of docs/math-foundations.md section 1.1 at the canonical configuration puts the third Dark Sphere at t = 10.769 s in slot 6, ahead of Force of Will's third cast at t = 16.0 s. W can only occupy index 6 if the scenario carries >48.6 ability haste with Scatter the Weak excluded from the custom order, or if the opening consumes three slots instead of four (an E-free order containing R), or if a second Dark Sphere charge is legitimately unlocked (>= 40 splinters, which would in fact push W later, not earlier). Absent evidence that the scenario sits in one of those corners, the correct index-6 slot is Q and the new value is a regression. Caveat recorded above: the scenario definition is outside the permitted evidence tree, so if it turns out the custom order omits Scatter the Weak and the build carries >= 49 ability haste, the new value W is the correct one instead.
